correctness.rationale: Condition on disjoint two-category block totals M,L with multinomial(N;a,b,1-a-b). Within-block allocations are independent biased binomial signs; f_theta(m)=E|sum_{j<=m} +/-1| is nondecreasing in m by the exact signed-drift identity and reflection. Given L=ell, M~Bin(N-ell,a/(1-b)), so h(ell)=E f_theta(M) is nonincreasing. Endpoint values h(0)>0=h(N), f_phi(0)=0<f_phi(N), and P(L=0),P(L=N)>0 force a strictly negative independent-copy covariance for every N>=1, p1..p4>0. Independent Poisson sample total produces independent category Poisson counts and covariance zero. Recomputed 18 asymmetric/uniform finite-N exact rational covariances; proof handles all N and masses.
